Name: Random Faction (Will not count toward the gold limit)
War Tribes
Strengths: Unmatched in melee power and mass.
Weaknesses: Relies on brute force of melee infantry.

Name: Central Kingdoms
Strengths: Excellent elite heavy infantry and cavalry.
Weaknesses: Mediocre early units. Lacks elite ranged units.
Description: The feudal communities of the Central Kingdoms are among the most traditional. They believe in absolute chivalry and tolerate change to a certain degree. The core structure of this society is as follows: humans are the worldly authorities of the civilised world, and housekins are the loyal workforce of the community.

Name: Homeward Hordes
Strengths: Can inflict myriad plagues and poison.
Weaknesses: High upkeep and low reserve number.
Description: There are many civilisations that fell to ruin and were forgotten by history. These ancient people lost their homes and place in the world. With necromancy magic, the dead rise once more to reclaim what was once theirs. The living are now their new enemy.

Name: New World Settlers
Weaknesses: No native troops or leaders of its own.

Name: Oasis Commonwealth
Weaknesses: Relies on magical powers to compete in late period.

Name: Doll Family
Description: The Doll Family is made up of ancient artificial beings long forgotten; they exist even longer than the north-western undead. Scholars hypothesise that these dolls are golem servants created by a long-lost civilisation. Hostile to all living beings, these dolls refuse most integration with other cultures.

Name: Highland Clans
Weaknesses: Focus on offence rather than defence.

Name: Small People
Description: The Small People are, as the name implies, a society made up mostly of creatures of small stature within the verts around the central continent. They are friendly to all small and vert beings. Many believe them to be savage, capable of only low-level civilisation at best. The wises, however, never underestimate what they are capable of.

Name: Neutral
Description: Those with a free spirit do not belong to a rooted society of their birthplace. They will travel the world and perhaps join any faction they visit.
